title: Stack trace returned to the client in javascript — review required
description: The error handler serializes err.stack into the HTTP response. A stack trace names internal files, functions, dependencies and sometimes query fragments or configuration values, which shortens an attacker’s path to a working exploit. The rule matches the response sink; whether the branch is reachable in production is a review decision.
remediation: Return a generic error body with a correlation id, log the stack server-side, and expose details only behind an authenticated diagnostics route.
limitation: Lexical: matches .send/.json carrying err.stack on one line; custom error serializers are out of scope.
